svg.title: The shell estimate uses positivity of a time average. Let μ, ν be the scalar spectral measures of a compact word combination and its adjoint word combination, both supported in the forward cone, with total mass sum at most M. Their characteristic-function difference A(x, t) = bμ(x, t)−bν(−x, −t) is the vacuum commutator pairing. Locality gives A(x, t) = 0 whenever |x| > R and |t| ≤1, with R uniform in the character: the words have fixed compact test supports and the label action is common across phases. Define
